problem_statement: Add DECLARE_CONSTANT to core/include/kernel_defines.h. When called as DECLARE_CONSTANT(foo, (uintptr_t)((void *) 7) & 3), it must declare a constant named foo whose value is 3, and make foo usable where C requires an integer constant expression: foo must work in static_assert(foo == 3), and char test_array[foo] must be a fixed-size array of 3 elements (not a variable-length array). This must hold even though the expression (uintptr_t)((void *) 7) & 3 is a compile-time constant but is not an integer constant expression.
